verdict.rationale: Schema evolution is a fair question for an ELT tool like Meltano, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers catalog generation and stream/property selection, which choose what to extract rather than detect and propagate upstream schema changes. Nothing documents schema-change detection or a user-chosen evolution policy.

support.subject: As a data engineer, upstream schema changes are detected and propagated by a policy I choose, instead of silently breaking loads
